Which statement about electrolysis is correct?
A
Electrons move through the electrolyte from the cathode to the anode.
B
Electrons move in the external circuit towards the cathode.
C
Negative ions move in the external circuit towards the anode.
D
Positive ions move through the electrolyte towards the anode.

options.label: A
options.text: Electrons move through the electrolyte from the cathode to the anode.

options.label: B
options.text: Electrons move in the external circuit towards the cathode.

options.label: C
options.text: Negative ions move in the external circuit towards the anode.

options.label: D
options.text: Positive ions move through the electrolyte towards the anode.
